author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Xavier Edwards logs four hits Tuesday
desc: Xavier Edwards went 4-for-6 with a double, two runs scored and an RBI in Tuesday's 14-3 victory over the Colorado Rockies.
impact: Edwards recorded his first four-hit game of the season, raising his batting average to .304. He is currently riding a nine-game hitting streak, during which he has collected one home run and two doubles.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Leo Jimenez records three hits Tuesday
desc: Leo Jimenez went 3-for-4 with a double, a walk, two runs scored and one RBI in Tuesday's 14-3 victory over the Colorado Rockies.
impact: Jimenez drew the start on Tuesday, his second straight, and took full advantage by recording his first three-hit game of the season. He has gone 4-for-6 with two doubles and a walk during the series against the Rockies, but he remains best left on waivers due to his limited playing time and season-long .221 AVG and .587 OPS.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Eury Perez strikes out eight in win Tuesday
desc: Eury Perez allowed one run on two hits and four walks while striking out eight across 5.1 innings in Tuesday's 14-3 victory over the Colorado Rockies.
impact: Perez was handed a four-run lead by the third inning and took full advantage, allowing just two hits while striking out eight. He has looked sharp in two starts since returning from the injured list, allowing two runs on five hits and four walks while striking out nine across 10 innings. His next scheduled start is on Sunday against the Athletics.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Joe Mack blasts homer Tuesday
desc: Joe Mack went 1-for-4 with a two-run home run in Tuesday's 14-3 victory over the Colorado Rockies.
impact: Mack managed just one hit in the Marlins' 14-run outburst, but he made it count with a 450-foot home run off John Brebbia in the seventh inning. He finished June with an impressive .294/.360/.544 slash line, adding five home runs, 14 runs scored and 15 RBI across 68 at-bats.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Owen Caissie goes yard Tuesday
desc: Owen Caissie went 1-for-4 with a home run, two runs scored and three RBI in Tuesday's 14-3 victory over the Colorado Rockies.
impact: Caissie capped off the Marlins' blowout victory with a towering 453-foot, three-run home run in the eighth inning, extending Miami's lead to 11 runs. He finished June slashing .246/.324/.541 with four home runs and three doubles across 61 at-bats.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Javier Sanoja homers Tuesday
desc: Javier Sanoja went 3-for-5 with a home run, three runs scored and three RBI in Tuesday's 14-3 victory over the Colorado Rockies.
impact: Sanoja followed up Monday's homer-shy-of-the-cycle performance with another strong showing on Tuesday, collecting three hits, including a 419-foot, three-run home run in the third inning. He finished June slashing .300/.306/.471 with two home runs and two stolen bases across 70 at-bats.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Junior Caminero homers in fifth straight game
desc: Junior Caminero went 2-for-5 with a home run, one run scored and three RBI in Tuesday's 10-4 win over the Kansas City Royals.
impact: Caminero has been the hottest hitter in baseball, homering in five straight games while launching seven home runs during that streak. Over his last seven games, he has slashed .481/.548/1.370 with eight home runs, nine runs scored and 18 RBI. He'll look to extend his home run streak to six games on Wednesday against Seth Lugo and the Royals.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Ryan Vilade hits homer in win Tuesday
desc: Ryan Vilade went 1-for-3 with a home run, a walk, two runs scored and an RBI in Tuesday's 10-4 win over the Kansas City Royals.
impact: Vilade drew the start with left-hander Noah Cameron on the mound and connected on a 416-foot solo home run in the third inning. He showcased his power throughout June, slashing .580 with four home runs and three doubles across 50 at-bats. Vilade owns an impressive .827 OPS across 126 at-bats this season, though inconsistent playing time has limited his fantasy value.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Griffin Jax picks up win Tuesday
desc: Griffin Jax allowed three runs on five hits and no walks while striking out five across six innings in Tuesday's 10-4 win over the Kansas City Royals.
impact: Jax displayed excellent command, issuing no walks, but was hurt by the long ball. He surrendered a solo homer to Carter Jensen in the first inning and a two-run shot to Bobby Witt Jr. in the third. Aside from those two mistakes, he turned in his first quality start of the 2026 season. Over six starts in June, he posted a 3.30 ERA and 1.13 WHIP with 31 strikeouts across 30 innings. His next scheduled start is on Sunday against the Houston Astros.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Lourdes Gurriel Jr. blasts home run Tuesday
desc: Lourdes Gurriel Jr. went 2-for-5 with a home run and three RBI in the Diamondbacks 8-2 win over the Giants on Tuesday.
impact: Gurriel got the scoring going early for Arizona with a three-run blast in the first inning. He is 10-for-45 at the plate since returning from the injured list in the middle of June.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ketel Marte goes deep in fourth straight game Tuesday
desc: Ketel Marte went 2-for-5 with a home run and three RBI in the Diamondbacks 8-2 win over the Giants on Tuesday.
impact: Marte was red hot to end June with a home run in four straight games to end the month. He also added a two-run single to give him 17 home runs and 53 RBI on the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brandon Pfaadt deals in win Tuesday
desc: Brandon Pfaadt allowed one run on three hits over 5 1/3 innings with two strikeouts and one walk in a win on Tuesday against the Giants.
impact: Pfaadt was fantastic on a day he was called up to make a spot start. The lone damage came via a solo home run hit by Luis Arraez. He is scheduled to face the Padres next.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Bubba Chandler takes loss Tuesday
desc: Bubba Chandler allowed five runs on seven hits over 6 1/3 innings with six strikeouts and two walks in a loss on Tuesday against the Phillies.
impact: Chandler struggled on a night where he didn't force many whiffs. He'll look to bounce back against the Nationals.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Manny Machado goes yard Monday
desc: Manny Machado went 2-for-5 with a home run in the Padres 9-7 loss on Tuesday against the Cubs.
impact: Machado cut the deficit to 5-3 with a two-run blast in the third inning off Matthew Boyd. He finishes June hitting .220 with six home runs.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Fernando Tatis Jr. blasts two home runs Tuesday
desc: Fernando Tatis Jr. went 2-for-5 with two home runs in the Padres 9-7 loss against the Cubs on Tuesday.
impact: Tatis opened the game with a 425-foot blast. He later capped off a four-run eighth inning with another solo blast. He is up to five home runs on the season.
